name: fast-jev-compaction-local
description: Local hardened fast-jev compaction: Jev-only (never a Claude summary), conservative tool relevance scoring, result previews, sharded dialogue context, bounded retries.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key, kept in Claude Code secure storage. Falls back to TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment; not read from settings.json.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call, tool result, or old assistant text is still relevant; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

ceilingPercent.title: Ceiling after compaction
ceilingPercent.description: The most a compaction may leave, as a context percentage in real tokens. What stays is decided by content: every old tool call Jev does not keep is collapsed to one line naming its page. Only past this ceiling are kept calls collapsed too. 0: two thirds of the compaction percentage.

keepAbove.title: Keep score (keep-or-page question)
keepAbove.description: With the keep-or-page question: an old tool call stays whole when Jev's score is at least this; every other old call is collapsed to one line naming its page, which the model reads back when needed. Measured 27.09: 0.4 keeps about a quarter of old output and 1.6x more of what is needed soon than a random choice of that size.

questionVariant.title: Jev question
questionVariant.description: keep_or_page (default): stay in context or is the page enough. relevance: the older question (is the information still needed), scored no better than random on 27.09 for paging.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to apply Jev output. Below it the session is left unchanged; this local fork never falls back to Claude summarization.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated ceiling for per-batch Jev state. Dialogue text is never abridged; hard-clamped below Jev's 32k state+longest-question limit.

maxJevRequests.title: Jev requests per pass
maxJevRequests.description: Soft request budget (16 by default). Largest eligible outputs are checked first; each candidate always gets full dialogue coverage. Remaining candidates stay unchanged for the next pass. One complete shard group may exceed this budget.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated ceiling for one whole Jev request. Jev 1.13 allows 64k total; local fork keeps a safety margin.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head and tail
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters retained at EACH end of a shortened result or of a paged-out long input field; 0 keeps only the page pointer. Action records are retained for tools that may have side effects.

resultPreviewChars.title: Tool result preview for Jev
resultPreviewChars.description: Characters from each end of a tool result shown to Jev while judging informational relevance.

compactAssistantText.title: Compact old assistant text
compactAssistantText.description: Optional experimental scoring/removal of old assistant text. Disabled by default. When false, all user and assistant text is preserved verbatim and only tool calls/results are compacted.
